name: bdx
description: Beads workflow skills and hooks for durable planning, lightweight feature builds, per-increment assurance, handoff, and closure.

interface.shortDescription: Durable Beads workflows for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Plan, attach, build ordinary features in a tight durable loop, choose per-increment slices when the evidence requires them, then summarize and close Beads tasks.
defaultPrompt: Plan this work as a durable Beads task.
Attach this session to an existing Beads task.
Build the next planned feature milestone with tight feedback and durable progress.
Run independently reviewed slices for each increment of this feature.
